Class AbstractTransactWriteBuilder<S extends AbstractTransactWriteBuilder<S>>

java.lang.Object
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.base.AbstractTransactWriteBuilder<S>
Type Parameters:
S - the concrete builder type (for fluent chaining)
Direct Known Subclasses:
AsyncTransactWriteBuilder, TransactWriteBuilder
public abstract class AbstractTransactWriteBuilder<S extends AbstractTransactWriteBuilder<S>> extends Object
Abstract base for sync and async transactional write builders.

Manages operations (put, update, delete, condition check), consumed capacity settings, and low-level request item building shared across sync and async variants.
